day_shape: 47 items: Rubio says progress made on Iran file with possible announcement in coming days, JPost reports US-Iran near 60-day ceasefire extension, IDF strikes Bekaa and south Lebanon with multi-village evacuation alerts, heavy regime-channel cycle marking third of Khordad.

threads.label: US-Iran ceasefire extension reporting
threads.summary: Secretary of State Rubio said progress had been made on the Iran file and the US might have 'something to say' in coming days, per Jerusalem Post. A separate JPost report said Washington and Tehran were near a 60-day extension of the current ceasefire, while Times of Israel reported Trump was weighing new strikes amid frustration with talks.

threads.label: IDF strikes and Lebanon evacuation alerts
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck Hezbollah sites with at least five reported killed in south Lebanon, and conducted an overnight raid on an underground Hezbollah site in the Bekaa. IDF Arabic spokesperson Avichay Adraee issued evacuation orders for multiple villages around Nabatiyeh and Jezzine, citing ceasefire breaches.

threads.label: Iran diplomacy with Pakistan and region
threads.summary: Defa Press reported Pakistan Army chief Asim Munir concluded a visit to Iran with 'encouraging progress towards a final understanding', and posted images of Foreign Minister Araghchi seeing him off. Defa Press also said Araghchi held phone calls with the Qatari and Egyptian foreign ministers and that armed forces chief Bagheri rejected the idea of carrying threats through Pakistan's envoy.

threads.label: Regime messaging to Hezbollah and Gaza
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press published the text of a message from Araghchi to Hezbollah Secretary-General Naim Qassem pledging continued support, alongside a Defa Press claim of a Hezbollah Ababil drone flight over northern Israel and destruction of two Iron Dome launchers. Defa Press also reported five Gaza police officers and a child killed in an Israeli airstrike on northern Gaza, with a Hamas condemnation.

threads.label: Khamenei domestic mobilisation cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted a message marking the second anniversary of President Raisi's death and the 'third of Khordad', framing Iranians' resistance against 'two terrorist armies' as raising officials' duties. The office also publicised bank details and a USSD code for public donations to war-affected and needy compatriots, while IRIB and Defa Press ran commemorations of the 'imposed war Ramadan' martyrs and unexploded-ordnance disposal in Bandar Abbas.

The leader of the Ansarallah movement in Yemen criticised the economic dependence of Islamic and Arab countries on foreign powers, describing sanctions and economic pressures as one of the most important tools of war against nations and emphasised that enemies widely use sanctions and economic blockade as weapons to advance their objectives. events.title_en: The Hill: 90 per cent of Americans fear continued price increases
events.summary_en: The Hill: 90 per cent of Americans fear continued price increases. American newspaper The Hill reported in an article: Results of a poll by JD Power Institute show that nine out of every ten Americans are concerned about rising prices of everyday goods in the coming three months. Prices are rising due to the energy shock resulting from America and Israel's war against Iran, and more than 70 per cent of respondents stated they paid more for petrol last month. Finally, more than 60 per cent of Americans emphasised that rising prices of everyday consumer goods prevented them from making larger purchases last month.

events.summary_en: Memorandum of understanding signed for construction of Minab martyrs garden. The memorandum of understanding for cooperation on construction of the Minab martyrs garden between the Razavi Khorasan Shrine and the Foundation for Martyrs and Veterans' Affairs was signed. The signing ceremony for the memorandum of understanding for cooperation on construction of the Minab martyrs garden between the Razavi Khorasan Shrine and the Foundation for Martyrs and Veterans' Affairs took place this Saturday afternoon, 2 Khordad, in the presence of Mohammad Hossein Estad Aqa, Chief Executive of the Keramat-e Razavi Foundation, and Yaqoub Suleimani, Deputy for Culture and Education of the Foundation for Martyrs and Veterans' Affairs. Announcement of ideas and plans, beginning the implementation process by Azar month and creating a comprehensive complex for commemorating the memory and injustice of these martyrs to domestic and international audiences before the anniversary of these martyrs were among the details of this memorandum.

events.title_en: The mask has fallen... The masks have fallen
events.summary_en: The mask has fallen... The masks have fallen. The falling of masks was not the work of a moment but the result of a long labour that facts had exposed and events within it proved that ringing slogans were nothing but a cover for schemes that bear no resemblance to homelands in any way. Hezbollah stands today exposed before history and peoples; after promises evaporated and the clear truth appeared: Hezbollah is an enemy of Lebanon and the Lebanese and an enemy of all those who wish to live in peace.

events.title_en: During the hours of last night, the IDF conducted a raid in the Bekaa region on an underground site belonging to the Hezbollah terrorist organisation which it used to produce combat means designated for attacking Israeli citizens and IDF forces operating in southern Lebanon.
events.summary_en:
During the hours of last night, the IDF conducted a raid in the Bekaa region on an underground site belonging to the Hezbollah terrorist organisation which it used to produce combat means designated for attacking Israeli citizens and IDF forces operating in southern Lebanon.

Infrastructure belonging to the Hezbollah terrorist organisation in the Tyre area, which it used to plan and execute terrorist schemes against IDF forces, was also targeted.

Before carrying out the raids, a number of steps were taken aimed at reducing the likelihood of civilian casualties, including issuing advance warnings to residents and using types of precise ammunition, aerial reconnaissance and other intelligence information.
